# View lines no screen draws, checked by
# .github/scripts/unpictured.sh.
# Each ScreenID is opened on its own, so
# only what a screen shows runs; lines here
# are expected not to. A file name, then
# its lines (indented, as trimmed text),
# with a # comment saying why. Lines of
# only brackets or quotes are skipped.

# Taps: pick a skill, tap a unit, end the
# turn, and start again.
BattleView.swift
  fight.target(unit.id)
  fight.restart()
  fight.endTurn()
  fight.choose(index)

# Taps: the foes' next step, or all of
# them.
  fight.advance()
  fight.skip()

# Tap: open or fold the knocked-out
# section (battleFallen shows it open).
  showsFallen = $0

# Opening the battle info sheet, and what
# it holds (pictured as its own screen,
# battleInfo).
  showsInfo = true
  NavigationStack {
  BattleInfoView(battle: fight.battle)

# Tap: close the sheet.
BattleInfoView.swift
  dismiss()

# Taps: take a pick off, or add a unit to
# a side.
PickerView.swift
  lineup.remove(at: place, from: side)
  lineup.add(index, to: .party)
  lineup.add(index, to: .foes)

# Taps: commit or undo a planned move.
MovePanel.swift
  fight.commit()
  fight.undo()

# Pressing and letting go of an arrow.
NudgePad.swift
  fight.press(way)
  fight.press(nil)

# The commander's orders: restore, ward
# or pass.
CommandPanel.swift
  fight.command(.pass)
  fight.command(order)

# Pressing and letting go of an orbit
# arrow on the arena (or its touch being
# cancelled).
OrbitArrows.swift
  held = way
  pinned = $1 == nil ? nil : fight.rim
  fight.press($1)

# Touches on the arena, as they move and
# when they lift.
ArenaView.swift
  touched($0, on: map)
  touched($0, on: map, lifted: true)
  let moved = !ArenaMap.isTap(
  touch.translation
  fight.touch(
  map.spot(at: touch.location),
  moved: moved,
  lifted: lifted
